r0.t: Drawing pain from region of kidneys to inguinal glands, with anxiety in scrobiculum

r1.t: Anxiety with unsuccessful urging to urinate, without there being much urine in the bladder

r2.t: Apprehensive of danger without fear, with pain in bladder

r3.t: Retention of urine with a boy of eleven months, screams awfully, throws things away from him

r5.t: Talkative delirium, with violent pains in bladder

r7.t: Urine passed off unconsciously in mania

r8.t: Urine passed off unconsciously in mania, when busily occupied she has to stop and pass quickly a few drops of water

r10.t: Painful urination, when thinking of it a contracting pain running backward from the fore¬ part of the urethra

r11.t: Urine Copious. Cheerfulness after copious urination

r12.t: Much thirst, much urine and great exhaustion

r15.t: Profuse flow of burning urine, drunken feeling

r16.t: Clear like spring water, con¬ fused all night

r17.t: Water-like urine in quantities, vivid delirium

r18.t: Urine Scanty. Frequent desire to pass urine, but in small quantities, with apprehension of some impending evil

r19.t: Urine pale and scanty with attacks of mental derangement

r20.t: Scanty and much reddened, with hallucinations

r21.t: Scanty and red colored, with idiocy

r22.t: Very little, but frequent discharges of milky urine, with unconsciousness and delirium in hydrocephalus

r24.t: Urination, anxiety during urination, and pressure in the bladder, with scanty urine

r25.t: Urination, great depression and anxiety before and after urination

r27.t: Urination, impatience before urinating, before, during and after urination violent cutting pains in the urethra, has to bend double and scream

r28.t: Urination, is kind of frightened when going to urinate
